masteryZone.q: To which clan did Mahavira's father Siddhartha belong?
masteryZone.sol: Siddhartha belonged to the Jnatrika Kshatriya clan.

masteryZone.q: Vardhamana was born in Kundagrama near Vaishali in 540 BCE.
masteryZone.sol: Yes, Kundagrama is widely accepted as his birthplace.

masteryZone.q: The name of Mahavira's daughter was ______.
masteryZone.sol: Anojja (or Priyadarsana) was the name of his daughter.

masteryZone.q: At what age did Mahavira leave his home to become an ascetic?
masteryZone.sol: He left his home at the age of 30 after the death of his parents.

masteryZone.q: Makkhali Gosala accompanied Mahavira for six years and founded the Ajivika sect.
masteryZone.sol: Yes, Makkhali Gosala wandered with Mahavira before separating over doctrinal differences.

masteryZone.q: What is the central doctrine of Makkhali Gosala's Ajivika sect?
masteryZone.sol: Niyati or absolute pre-determination (fatalism) is the central doctrine.

masteryZone.q: On the banks of which river did Mahavira attain Kevala Jnana?
masteryZone.sol: He attained Kevala Jnana on the banks of Rijupalika River.

masteryZone.q: The title 'Kevalin' means one who has conquered all sensory desires.
masteryZone.sol: Jina means 'Conqueror'; Kevalin means 'Omniscient' (possessor of absolute knowledge).

masteryZone.q: Match the epithet with its correct meaning:
masteryZone.sol: Correct matches: Jina - Conqueror, Kevalin - Omniscient, Nigrantha - Free from bonds, Mahavira - Great Hero.

masteryZone.q: Where did Mahavira attain Nirvana (final liberation)?
masteryZone.sol: He attained Nirvana at Pavapuri in 468 BCE.

masteryZone.q: Sudharma was the only chief disciple (Gandhara) who survived Mahavira.
masteryZone.sol: Yes, Sudharma survived Mahavira and became the first head of the Jain Church.

masteryZone.q: The fifth vow added by Mahavira to Jainism was ______.
masteryZone.sol: Brahmacharya (Chastity) was the fifth vow added by him.
